clips.title: The story
paras: The Call of Water is a spiritual trial for shamans seeking the sacred water totem rites. By delivering pure water blessed by Hervdana to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan, seekers prepare the elemental sapta necessary to commune with spirits at Stendel's Pond.

The Call of Water represents an essential trial of spiritual attunement for aspiring shamans seeking harmony with the element of water. Undertaking this path requires gathering water blessed by Hervdana herself, proving both patience and reverence for the spirits before bringing the vessel to Norric Lochthane in Loch Modan.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Norric will have one more task for ye before rewarding ye with the water totem rites. The vial of water I've given ye is necessary for whatever that task is. Go now and find him. We shall meet again some day.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello again, friend. Yer looking well.
What brings you back to me so soon?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahh, water blessed by Hervdana herself, and gathered by your own hands? A gift indeed.

These vials shall birth your sapta, letting you glimpse the water spirits at Stendel's Pond, near Moonbrook. The last few drops of the water have an equally important purpose... Waste not even a cork stopper dampened with sacred water.
